data.schema_note: two parquet schemas in one split; read file-by-file, columns prompt/chosen/rejected (+ language or target_language)

baselines.note: label 1 = candidate_b chosen, so negative weights favour candidate_a; lists are mapped to chosen/rejected accordingly

data.construction: per the dataset card, kimi-k3 localized the prompt and chosen response and deliberately generated a rejected response with poor translation, English loan words or US-centric content

hyperparameters.loss: soft cross-entropy over the two choice options

training.selection: lowest loss on the val_calib half; val_eval is never used for selection

calibration.method: temperature scaling, single scalar T = exp(log_T), L-BFGS on NLL
calibration.note: headline ECE/NLL are on val_eval (held out from the fit); val_calib numbers are in-sample for the fit and therefore optimistic

margin.note: over both presentation orders (2 x n_pairs instances)

latency.method: batch size 1, 20 warm-up passes, then 200 timed passes over 200 distinct val_eval pairs; torch.cuda.synchronize() before and after each timed pass; forward = host->device copy + model + logits back to host; tokenization = token-level truncation + laya sequence building
latency.target_criterion: median GPU forward pass at batch size 1 on real inputs

recommended.rule: lowest routed fraction within 0.5% of the best cascade accuracy in the sweep

label_noise.rule: judge prefers the rejected response in both orders AND gate's order-averaged P(chosen) <= 0.30

probe.design: 299 UltraFeedback pairs (seed 20261014, GPT-4 rating margin >= 1.0, <= 3500 English chars) rewritten into natural Swedish by kimi-k3 with identical instructions for both answers, content and errors preserved; label = higher-rated answer

likely_training_overlap.rule: char 3-5-gram TF-IDF cosine >= 0.8 to the nearest training prompt

cpu_inference.method: batch 1; collate + forward + logits to host; tokenization excluded; 100 runs over the first 50 val_eval pairs

mt_naturalness.prompt: 'Översätt följande text till svenska:' + English source

liu_translationese.metric: share of pairs where the human alternative is preferred (order-averaged P > 0.5 for pairwise questions; strictly higher score for single-response questions, ties count 0.5); trailing punctuation stripped as in the paper

judge.metric: per pair, the share of the two slot orders in which the human version won; a pair counts as human-preferred when both orders pick it (0.5 = split)

context_length.data: val_eval (original DPO pairs and fluent pairs), both slot orders, preference
context_length.note: all checkpoints were trained at 1024 tokens; longer inputs are unseen lengths

external_eval.metric: share of pairs where the reference (corrected sentence, own FAQ answer, human translation) is preferred; pairwise questions average P over both slot orders (> 0.5 wins), single-response questions compare scores (ties 0.5)
